alpha_hypothesis.text: Accepted-stack residual losses may be concentrated in early follow-through failure or moderate-MFE full-reversal families after known add-on, low-MFE, wide-stop, and state-map families are removed.
alpha_hypothesis.why_not_production: Observed-only taxonomy; no filter or strategy logic changed. Candidate must pass a future default-off replay with entry/early-path observable fields and winner-collateral accounting.

historical_guardrail_check.mechanism_insight_check: This run does not tune thresholds, expand candidate pools, add filters, retest add-on enablement, retest generic low-MFE exits, retest wide-stop distance, or modify production code. It only quantifies the residual accepted-stack loss family.

window.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy profits but lags indexes
mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

family_definitions.moderate_mfe_full_reversal_stopout: Loss stopout with at least 1pct MFE and target progress below 50pct, then reversal to stop; excludes low-MFE and add-on-touched known families.
family_definitions.early_followthrough_underperformance: Within two bars after entry, close is below entry open and underperforms SPY; tests a failed initial acceptance path rather than a broad threshold change.
family_definitions.loss_cluster_same_entry_date: Entry dates with at least two accepted-stack losses across the three-window audit, suggesting same-day tape/context fragility.
family_definitions.gap_or_open_damage_after_entry: Post-entry overnight/open damage of at least 1.25pct or 0.4R; observed damage path, not a rule.
family_definitions.event_strategy_residual_loss: Residual losing trades from earnings/event-style sleeve after excluding known families.

candidate_next_experiments.next_test_shape: Default-off shadow replay of a candidate risk/exit qualifier; must use only fields observable by entry plus first two bars, and must compare avoided losers against matched winners across all three windows.

interpretation: The audit is descriptive and cannot justify a direct filter because several residual families use post-entry path information.
A valid next experiment should convert the strongest residual family into a default-off replay using only entry-observable or explicitly early-lifecycle fields.
Good-trade collateral is explicitly measured by applying the same family tags to all accepted-stack winners. Families with high collateral_to_loss_abs should not be promoted.
